arguments.sql_query:
WITH stroke_candidates AS (
  SELECT c.concept_id, c.concept_name
  FROM omop.concept c
  WHERE c.domain_id='Condition' AND c.standard_concept='S'
    AND (
      LOWER(c.concept_name) IN ('cerebrovascular accident','cerebral infarction','ischemic stroke','hemorrhagic stroke','intracerebral hemorrhage','subarachnoid hemorrhage')
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%cerebral infarction%'
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%ischemic stroke%'
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%intracerebral hemorrhage%'
      OR LOWER(c.concept_name) LIKE '%subarachnoid hemorrhage%'
    )
), stroke_desc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ca.descendant_concept_id, sc.concept_name AS ancestor_name
  FROM stroke_candidates sc
  JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id=sc.concept_id
)
SELECT TOP 30 co.condition_concept_id, c.concept_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.visit_occurrence_id) AS inpatient_visits
FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
JOIN stroke_desc sd ON sd.descendant_concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
JOIN omop.visit_occurrence v ON v.visit_occurrence_id=co.visit_occurrence_id AND v.visit_concept_id=9201
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
GROUP BY co.condition_concept_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY inpatient_visits DESC

I found the database is SQL Server/OMOP. I’m now using `TOP`/T‑SQL and a predefined comorbidity panel to compute readmission odds ratios.

arguments.sql_query:
WITH stroke_roots AS (
  SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (443454,381316,4310996,4148906,432923,4046362)
), stroke_concepts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor ca JOIN stroke_roots sr ON ca.ancestor_concept_id=sr.concept_id
  UNION SELECT concept_id FROM stroke_roots
), stroke_visits AS (
  SELECT v.person_id, v.visit_occurrence_id, v.visit_start_date, v.visit_end_date,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY v.person_id ORDER BY v.visit_start_date, v.visit_occurrence_id) AS rn
  FROM omop.visit_occurrence v
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.visit_occurrence_id=v.visit_occurrence_id
  JOIN stroke_concepts sc ON sc.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE v.visit_concept_id=9201 AND v.visit_start_date IS NOT NULL
), index_stroke AS (
  SELECT person_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_start_date, COALESCE(visit_end_date, visit_start_date) AS discharge_date
  FROM stroke_visits WHERE rn=1
), outcome AS (
  SELECT i.person_id, i.visit_occurrence_id, i.visit_start_date, i.discharge_date,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM omop.visit_occurrence v2
           WHERE v2.person_id=i.person_id AND v2.visit_concept_id=9201
             AND v2.visit_occurrence_id<>i.visit_occurrence_id
             AND v2.visit_start_date > i.discharge_date
             AND v2.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day,180,i.discharge_date)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS readmit_6mo
  FROM index_stroke i
), comorbidity_roots AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Atrial fibrillation',313217),('Heart failure',316139),('Chronic kidney disease',46271022),('End-stage renal disease/dialysis',46273164),
    ('COPD',255573),('Dementia',4182210),('Diabetes mellitus',201820),('Hypertension',316866),('Coronary arteriosclerosis',317576),
    ('Myocardial infarction',4329847),('Peripheral vascular disease',321052),('Hyperlipidemia',432867),('Malignancy',443392),('Obesity',433736),
    ('Sleep apnea',313459),('Anemia',439777),('Epilepsy/seizure disorder',380378),('Pneumonia',255848),('Depressive disorder',440383),
    ('Chronic liver disease',4212540),('Cirrhosis of liver',4064161),('Tobacco dependence',437264)
  ) AS x(comorbidity, root_concept_id)
), comorbidity_concepts AS (
  SELECT cr.comorbidity, ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM comorbidity_roots cr JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id=cr.root_concept_id
  UNION SELECT comorbidity, root_concept_id FROM comorbidity_roots
), patient_comorbidity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id, cc.comorbidity
  FROM outcome o
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=o.person_id AND co.condition_start_date <= o.visit_start_date
  JOIN comorbidity_concepts cc ON cc.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
), stats AS (
  SELECT cr.comorbidity,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NOT NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exposed_readmit,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NOT NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exposed_no_readmit,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unexposed_readmit,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unexposed_no_readmit,
         COUNT(*) AS cohort_n,
         SUM(o.readmit_6mo) AS total_readmit
  FROM comorbidity_roots cr
  CROSS JOIN outcome o
  LEFT JOIN patient_comorbidity pc ON pc.person_id=o.person_id AND pc.comorbidity=cr.comorbidity
  GROUP BY cr.comorbidity
)
SELECT TOP 25 comorbidity, cohort_n, total_readmit,
       exposed_readmit, exposed_no_readmit, unexposed_readmit, unexposed_no_readmit,
       CAST(1.0*exposed_readmit/NULLIF(exposed_readmit+exposed_no_readmit,0) AS decimal(10,4)) AS readmit_rate_exposed,
       CAST(1.0*unexposed_readmit/NULLIF(unexposed_readmit+unexposed_no_readmit,0) AS decimal(10,4)) AS readmit_rate_unexposed,
       CAST(((exposed_readmit+0.5)*(unexposed_no_readmit+0.5))/NULLIF((exposed_no_readmit+0.5)*(unexposed_readmit+0.5),0) AS decimal(10,3)) AS odds_ratio
FROM stats
WHERE exposed_readmit+exposed_no_readmit >= 30
ORDER BY odds_ratio DESC

  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.visit_occurrence_id=v.visit_occurrence_id
  JOIN stroke_concepts sc ON sc.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
  WHERE v.visit_concept_id=9201 AND v.visit_start_date IS NOT NULL
), index_stroke AS (

  FROM stroke_visits WHERE rn=1
), outcome AS (

             AND v2.visit_occurrence_id<>i.visit_occurrence_id
             AND v2.visit_start_date > i.discharge_date
             AND v2.visit_start_date <= DATEADD(day,180,i.discharge_date)
         ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS readmit_6mo
  FROM index_stroke i
), comorbidity_roots AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('Atrial fibrillation',313217),('Heart failure',316139),('Chronic kidney disease',46271022),('End-stage renal disease/dialysis',46273164),
    ('COPD',255573),('Dementia',4182210),('Diabetes mellitus',201820),('Hypertension',316866),('Coronary arteriosclerosis',317576),
    ('Myocardial infarction',4329847),('Peripheral vascular disease',321052),('Hyperlipidemia',432867),('Malignancy',443392),('Obesity',433736),
    ('Sleep apnea',313459),('Anemia',439777),('Epilepsy/seizure disorder',380378),('Pneumonia',255848),('Depressive disorder',440383),
    ('Chronic liver disease',4212540),('Cirrhosis of liver',4064161),('Tobacco dependence',437264)
  ) AS x(comorbidity, root_concept_id)
), comorbidity_concepts AS (
  SELECT cr.comorbidity, ca.descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM comorbidity_roots cr JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id=cr.root_concept_id
  UNION SELECT comorbidity, root_concept_id FROM comorbidity_roots
), patient_comorbidity AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.person_id, cc.comorbidity
  FROM outcome o
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=o.person_id AND co.condition_start_date <= o.visit_start_date
  JOIN comorbidity_concepts cc ON cc.concept_id=co.condition_concept_id
), stats AS (
  SELECT cr.comorbidity,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NOT NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS a,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NOT NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS b,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS c,
         SUM(CASE WHEN pc.person_id IS NULL AND o.readmit_6mo=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS d,
         COUNT(*) AS cohort_n,
         SUM(o.readmit_6mo) AS total_readmit
  FROM comorbidity_roots cr
  CROSS JOIN outcome o
  LEFT JOIN patient_comorbidity pc ON pc.person_id=o.person_id AND pc.comorbidity=cr.comorbidity
  GROUP BY cr.comorbidity
), calc AS (
  SELECT *,
    ((a+0.5)*(d+0.5))/NULLIF((b+0.5)*(c+0.5),0) AS or_val,
    SQRT(1.0/(a+0.5)+1.0/(b+0.5)+1.0/(c+0.5)+1.0/(d+0.5)) AS se
  FROM stats
  WHERE a+b >= 30
)
SELECT TOP 10 comorbidity, cohort_n, total_readmit,
       a AS exposed_readmit, b AS exposed_no_readmit,
       CAST(100.0*a/NULLIF(a+b,0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS readmit_pct_exposed,
       CAST(100.0*c/NULLIF(c+d,0) AS decimal(5,1)) AS readmit_pct_unexposed,
       CAST(or_val AS decimal(6,2)) AS odds_ratio,
       CAST(EXP(LOG(or_val)-1.96*se) AS decimal(6,2)) AS ci95_low,
       CAST(EXP(LOG(or_val)+1.96*se) AS decimal(6,2)) AS ci95_high
FROM calc
ORDER BY or_val DESC

content.text:
Using OMOP clinical records, I defined:

- Index stroke: first inpatient visit with stroke-related condition concepts.
- Outcome: any subsequent inpatient visit within 180 days after discharge.
- Comorbidity exposure: diagnosis present on/before index stroke date.
- Cohort: 21,781 index stroke patients; 8,327 had 6-month readmission (38.2%).

Strongest unadjusted associations with 6-month readmission:

| Rank | Comorbidity | Readmit % exposed | Readmit % unexposed | OR | 95% CI |
|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | Anemia | 47.8 | 31.3 | 2.01 | 1.90–2.12 |
| 2 | Pneumonia | 48.3 | 35.9 | 1.67 | 1.56–1.78 |
| 3 | Malignancy | 46.5 | 35.6 | 1.57 | 1.48–1.67 |
| 4 | Peripheral vascular disease | 47.9 | 36.9 | 1.57 | 1.44–1.70 |
| 5 | Chronic kidney disease | 46.0 | 36.2 | 1.50 | 1.41–1.61 |
| 6 | Epilepsy/seizure disorder | 47.2 | 37.4 | 1.49 | 1.36–1.64 |
| 7 | Chronic liver disease | 47.1 | 37.4 | 1.49 | 1.35–1.64 |
| 8 | Cirrhosis of liver | 47.4 | 37.9 | 1.48 | 1.28–1.71 |
| 9 | Obesity | 46.4 | 37.1 | 1.47 | 1.36–1.60 |
| 10 | Sleep apnea | 46.1 | 37.5 | 1.42 | 1.30–1.57 |

Bottom line: anemia showed the strongest association with 6-month post-stroke readmission, roughly doubling the odds. Other high-signal comorbidities clustered around cardiopulmonary/renal burden, frailty/complex illness, and neurologic complications. These are unadjusted odds ratios, so age, stroke severity, discharge disposition, and care utilization could confound the ranking.
